packages.name: Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.QuickGrid

prerequisites: Use net11.0, matching ASP.NET Core 11 runtime/reference/browser assets, Microsoft.NET.Sdk.Web, and a compatible Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.QuickGrid 11 package. Canonical pins: SDK 11.0.100-rc.2.26504.105; QuickGrid/Internal.Assets 11.0.0-rc.2.26504.105; C# 15.0.

No optional workloads, external provider, database, native SDK or account. Items is an in-memory IQueryable in this example. Enable Interactive Server only for /interactive; /static works without a circuit.
The QuickGrid package must supply lib/net11.0/Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.QuickGrid.dll and its static web assets; Web SDK Internal.Assets supplies the matching framework browser runtime.
constraints: Each grid owns a distinct PaginationState and three unique query names.

RC2 uses Title as sort identity; no dedicated ColumnId exists. Keep Title keys immutable and unique per grid; separate visible captions with HeaderTemplate and refresh custom links on LocationChanged.
Windows x64 static SSR and Interactive Server executed. WebAssembly/Auto, EF/provider translation, other OS, accessibility assistive technology and GA execution are unverified.
